note: Hood seen from BELOW (iso-bottom-right, true isometric, transparent background), roof away from the viewer, open cavity facing the viewer. Only the hood and the 4 F1 inserts are shown (Sole, boards hidden). Insertion direction is +z (up into the plinth, away from the viewer): each brass insert is pulled 16 mm straight down (screen: straight down) from its 3.6 mm blind hole in the plinth bottom face. arrow_to = pixel of the hole opening. Holes are at hood plinth corners (-5, 10.52), (-5, -33.38), (66.3, 10.52), (66.3, -33.38) mm, i.e. left, bottom, top, right corner of the plinth frame in the picture. The two round stubs inside the cavity are roof boss undersides (F3 side), not F1 holes.
